The '''Lontar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Lontar]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="RP" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lontar system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-9.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
